thread:
alex: FYI node gpu-aps3a-14 experienced a PSU voltage sag, then GPU fell off bus + correctable ECC spikes. Dropping out of the pool — need drain and replacement. anyone oncall?
maria: on it. can we cordon and drain now? run: `kubectl drain node/gpu-aps3a-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
sam: starting the drain now, migrating workloads to aps3b and eu-west fallback.
alex: logs (dmesg tail): ```[12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[12345.679012] pcieport 0000:65:00: backend error, resetting link
[12346.000123] ECC: 512 correctable errors detected on GPU 0```
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423 — node gpu-aps3a-14 degraded. paging oncall.
kyle: checking adjacent nodes aps3a-12/13/15 for similar symptoms now.
maria: quick infra note — rack PDU shows a brief 12V dip at 09:58, looks transient at the PDU level, likely PSU hardware. not a software rollback.
sam: drain progress: 24 pods evicted so far. latency SLOs increased ~5% but still within alerting thresholds.
alex: can we avoid cold cache storms when traffic shifts? recommend staged reroute and a few warmup replicas in aps3b.
maria: setting LB rule: aps3b 80% / eu-west 20% until replacement. applying now.
field-tech: I can be onsite in ~2h for PSU swap. want me to RMA full node or just swap PSU and run diagnostics?
kyle: swap PSU first, then run GPU healthcheck and stress tests. if card fails stress test, RMA GPU.
sam: note — eu-west fallback will increase per-token cost ~18% during spill. maria, can we get emergency budget sign-off? :thinking_face:
maria: approved emergency burst up to $1200 for this incident. please tag spend with incident=INC-2026-0423. :white_check_mark:
alex: after drain, mark node unschedulable and create maintenance ticket. I'll open MAINT-4591.
sam: commands I ran: ```kubectl cordon gpu-aps3a-14
kubectl drain gpu-aps3a-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
kubectl annotate node gpu-aps3a-14 redwood/incident=INC-2026-0423```
maria: i'll own the rollout and postmortem. drop system logs and kernel dump to /mnt/log-archive/aps3a-14 and add links to MAINT-4591.
oncall-bot: Runbook check: if ECC correctables > 1000 in 1h escalate to hw-team. current count: 512.
alex: thanks — keep this thread live. @field-tech ping when onsite so we can coordinate last-minute eviction and health checks. :thumbsup:
field-tech: will ping when I arrive, ETA ~2h. packing spares.
maria: added incident tags and billing note. updating the incident channel with current traffic mix.
sam: drain finished, node unschedulable, workloads shifted. monitoring for latency regressions for 30m.
kyle: I'll run GPU memtest and power-cycle after PSU swap. will post results here.
alex: great work team. we'll triage post-repair and close incident. remember to include a short blameless root-cause in the postmortem.
